replies.author: _Laugh_
replies.body:
1. That's not small, you want small? Go ask Theo
2. PvP is really messed up with it's Knockback bug and for it to be in small maps can kinda have the chance of you getting blown away by 12 blocks.
3. ^ This has been proven -> https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kp4h0O_YKYw

Edit: Soz but I'm giving a -1 because if it's gonna be small I suggest making it a square as getting kills will be faster just with the same amount of time.

Although this is a jungle theme I know Theo (1Theodore1) has made a Nexus Map before on MC Zone that was a Jungle theme and it was Square. The bases were small so you may need to reduce your own idea of how you set the bases out to be.
